summary: Made the two fixes the send-back asked for and nothing else. In tests/rules/RuleCases.ps1, every hard-coded parity string now matches the current counts (11 Facts, 15 twinned entries, 27 patterns, 24 settled). C-005's -ExpectFacts fixture is now 11 against 12. C-003's deletion lookahead is now (?=^  - name:|^  # settled by SL-), so it removes only its one entry. RuleCases C-001 to C-005 all hold at this tree. In MainWindow.ShowVolumeInUse the figure.IsCompleted shortcut is gone, so every ending reaches AddVolumeInUse through ContinueWith and Dispatcher.InvokeAsync. V-001 now runs that path: a mutation that skips the dispatcher makes it fail. All 28 non-network window cases pass, and the Core suite passes 240/240 in Debug and Release.

obligations.how: Updated every hard-coded count in RuleCases.ps1: lines 202-207, 267, 288, 332, 366, 371, 562, 587 and 595. The strings now read 'AGREE 11 facts <- 15 twinned entries, 27 patterns; 24 settled'; C-003's appended probe expects 25 settled, C-005's fixture reads 'found 11 Facts where the test class has 12' with -ExpectFacts 12, and the harness cases expect 'xunit 11 Facts' and 14 and 15 twinned entries. C-003's Edit-File lookahead is now (?=^  - name:|^  # settled by SL-). Ran RuleCases.ps1 -Case C-001 to C-005 at this tree: all exit 0, 'All checks held.' (8, 34, 26, 26 and 230 checks, 0 FAIL). C-006 to C-014 need the TAAD engine (-EnginePython/-EngineRoot) and were not run.

ShowVolumeInUse is now a single figure.ContinueWith(landed => Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() => AddVolumeInUse(landed, generation, detail)), ..., TaskScheduler.Default), with no IsCompleted shortcut. V-001 passes, and with a mutation that calls AddVolumeInUse off the dispatcher it fails on both of its runs (no report written). So V-001 now exercises the path a slow volume takes. After restoring the source, all 28 non-network window cases and the Core suite (240/240 in Debug and Release) pass.
